# The lowering's decisions that key on a std package or function name
# (TestLoweringKeysOnNoStdName, OPT4a ruling 2026-11-11). A line is
# `category<TAB>file:function<TAB>reason`.
# abi: a backend binding (a runtime type representation, a prelude
# collection wrapper, a std extern's ABI, a name the report writes).
# debt: an inherited optimizer; unit OPT6 retires it through a general fact,
# so the category ends empty. The inventory may only shrink.

abi	calls.go:funcCtx.callee	the call table's Callee text (#230): prelude functions are written unqualified in the defect report
abi	calls.go:lowerer.hostImportNames	the Go import list: std time is imported by the runtime ABI already, so it is not added twice
abi	decls.go:isPreludeType	the runtime type representation of the prelude's Option, Some and None
abi	decls.go:lowerer.intrinsic	the prelude collection wrappers Append and Put bind runtime/v1 bodies
abi	getmatch.go:getPattern	the prelude Some's field Value, the comma-ok form of the prelude Get
abi	getmatch.go:preludeGet	the prelude Map Get extern, whose Go form is the comma-ok map read
abi	gocall.go:funcCtx.goErrorCall	go.Is and go.As bind v1.GoIs and v1.GoAs (IG5)
abi	gocall.go:isOptionType	the runtime type representation of the prelude Option at a Go import boundary
abi	library.go:hostProvides	the host entry's capabilities Console and Ambient (rows.md, Entry 4)
abi	module.go:lowerer.hostFields	the host entry's capabilities Console and Ambient (rows.md, Entry 4)
abi	std.go:lowerer.runtimeType	the runtime type representation of the prelude Task (*rt.Task)
abi	types.go:lowerer.foreignOwner	the std package that owns a runtime type representation (prelude types are the program's)
abi	values.go:preludeAppend	the prelude Append extern's ABI: its argument is clipped before the runtime append
abi	values.go:preludeMapWrite	the prelude Put extern's ABI and Go's delete (the prelude Delete binds it): the map argument is cloned before the write
debt	machinerun.go:funcCtx.flatReturn	machines Run/From flat execution (the decision literal's Next and Output); OPT6
debt	machinerun.go:funcCtx.machineRun	machines Run/From flat execution; OPT6: Ergo-side inlining of the ordinary Run body
debt	machinerun.go:lowerer.flatRunOf	machines Run/From flat execution (Finished, Running, Rejected); OPT6
debt	refown.go:isSyncModify	sync.Modify owned handover; OPT6: ownership facts
debt	refown.go:isSyncRef	sync.Ref owned handover; OPT6: ownership facts
debt	refown.go:valueWalk.refCall	sync.Ref Update owned handover; OPT6: ownership facts
debt	update.go:mapsUpdate	maps.Update fusion; OPT6: Ergo-side inlining of the ordinary Update body
debt	values.go:valueWalk.fresh	slices.WithCapacity freshness; OPT6: OPT1's result-alias summary
